title: Battle of Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút", at revision 1379275053, opens: "The Battle of Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút was fought between the Vietnamese Tây Sơn forces and an army of Siam in present-day Kim Sơn commune, Đồng Tháp province of Vietnam on 20 January 1785." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1047091, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1785 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
